race.comment: TAG THE BRIDE (11) narrowly on top. She covered ground but didn't shirk the task first up at Ballarat Synthetic when fifth having started short on debut in a strong maiden. Expect improvement now and with luck early from the wide gate she'll take catching. EYES OF BLUE (8) struggled fresh as favourite at Bendigo but had shown good ability last time in and should strip much fitter onto a firmer surface. WATTEN ASSETT (5) was just fair first up at Sale when in the market but is another expected to kick on with that run under the belt. MIDNIGHT MAN (3) resumes. He showed some ability last time in and can run a good race fresh. ANGELOTTI (7) resumes with minor claims.
